operations.why: Item stack network IDs serialize as signed 32-bit integers. Compression belongs to each use: item descriptors are compressed, while slot and mine-block request IDs are fixed-width.

evidence.summary: Net Id Variant is optional varint32, matching the Compression annotation on the corresponding Mojang field.
Net Id Variant is int32 with no variable-length compression.
Net Id Variant is int32; the preceding Slot and Predicted Durability use varint32.
